## Key Ingredients and Mechanisms

| Ingredient | Primary Role |
|---|---|
| Passionflower | Calms overactive nerve signaling; supports rest and reduced tingling |
| Marshmallow Root | Protective coating for irritated nerve tissue; reduces touch sensitivity |
| Corydalis Powder | Interrupts pain signal pathways; targets burning and sharp discomfort |
| Prickly Pear | Antioxidant betalains; supports peripheral microcirculation |
| California Poppy Seed | Eases muscle tension and nerve-linked spasm |
| Microcrystalline Cellulose | Plant-based stabilizer for even ingredient distribution |

Dosage: 2 capsules daily with 8 oz water. Non-GMO, GMP-certified, FDA-registered facility, made in USA.

## How NerveHoney Works — Four-Phase Timeline

**Phase 1 (Weeks 1–2):** Passionflower and California Poppy Seed begin modulating overactive nerve signals. Reduced evening tingling and improved sleep.

**Phase 2 (Weeks 3–6):** Corydalis reaches effective tissue concentration; Marshmallow Root coats irritated nerve tissue. Measurable reduction in burning and sharp sensations.

**Phase 3 (Months 2–3):** Prickly Pear antioxidants improve peripheral microcirculation. Better blood flow to nerve tissue.

**Phase 4 (Months 4–6+):** Long-term nerve maintenance. 6-bottle supply recommended for full coverage.

Learn more at [How It Works](https://nervehoney-us.vercel.app/#how).
